content: {"reasoning":"The CO-197 denial assigns the missing-authorization balance to provider responsibility; the plan's 10% coinsurance alone does not establish patient liability for this denied service. Retroactive authorization and peer-to-peer review are unavailable, two necessity appeals have already failed, and correcting the diagnosis pairing would not resolve the authorization denial. With no secondary payer or established collectible patient responsibility, billing the remaining balance is improper despite the isolated historical success.","action":"write_off"}
